name: Dylan's Aesop's Fables
subtitle: A fable a day, with its moral
description: One of Aesop's fables every day, the same one as on the wall: the whole story, with Milo Winter's color picture from The Aesop for Children (1919), and its moral.
105 fables, from the Tortoise and the Hare to the Boy Who Cried Wolf, in a shuffled order: all of them before any comes back.
features: The whole story, and its moral
